newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom Malaysia '96 net profit up 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Telekom Malaysia '96 net profit up 19 pct.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd said on Thursday the group's net profit for 1996 rose 19.4 percent to 1.88 billion ringgit ($758 million), slightly above market analysts' forecasts.
Analysts had expected Telekom to announce net earnings of between 1.8 billion and 1.85 billion ringgit, against 1.575 in 1995.

Telekom said it was also proposing one bonus share for every two existing shares held by shareholders. The planned bonus issue will raise its issued and paid-up share capital to slightly under three billion ringgit.
The utility firm said its operating revenue was 6.42 billion ringgit for the year ended December 31, 1996, up from 5.25 billion in the previous year.
The higher profit was achieved on the back of "strong and continuous economic growth in Malaysia", the company said in a statement accompanying its financial results.
"The telecommunication environment is becoming competitive and the group is positioning itself to maintain its performance in 1997," it said.
